blocks.text: CANBERRA, Australia — Emerging maritime security issues, ranging from strategic competition and territorial disputes to cybersecurity and threats to undersea infrastructure, were key topics examined by 13 journalists from Southeast Asia during a weeklong fellowship in Australia. Two Philippine Daily Inquirer correspondents, Joanna Rose Aglibot of Zambales and Geraldford Ticke of Palawan, joined journalists from Indonesia, Malaysia and Vietnam in the Southeast Asia Maritime Media Fellowship held in Sydney and Canberra from Nov. 2 to 6. The Philippine delegation also included James Patrick De Jesus of People’s Television (PTV) Network and Katrina Manubay of the Manila Standard. READ: The territorial dispute […]...
